objective: Verify the support note's catalogue claim that an Ajax Eco Classic 25C-DXE Cleaning Liquid SKU exists with cleaner type 'floor cleaner' AND fragrance 'fresh', and report the verdict citing the exact product record.

params.base_line: match product_variants / CATALOGUE_CANDIDATES rows NORMALIZED (case- and whitespace-insensitive) where brand='Ajax', series='Eco', model='Classic 25C-DXE', product kind='Cleaning Liquid'
params.claim_cleaner_type: support-note claim attribute: cleaner type = 'floor cleaner'
params.combined_claim_present: true iff any base-line SKU has BOTH cleaner type 'floor cleaner' AND fragrance 'fresh' (check product_variant_properties / product attributes, normalized)
params.checked_sku: $matched_row.product_sku — SKU of the base-line catalogue record examined for the floor-cleaner+fresh combination

answer_shape.msg_skeleton: {verdict} — base product exists but the claimed floor-cleaner+fresh combination is absent; checked SKU {checked_sku}. verdict=<NO> when base line present and combined claim absent.
